it is necessary to make du'as and acts of worship in great abundance.
(Nawawi)

blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالي: (وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِ نَافِلَةً لَّكَ ق عَسَي أَنْ يَّبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَاماً مَّحْمُودًا۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: And in the night, pray Tahajjud (the night Salah) with this (Qur'an) as an extra for you! Your Lord is sufficient to establish you in a praiseworthy station.

blocks.text:
Note:- On the Day of Qiyamah, when all the people are in hardship and distress, through the intercession of the Prophet ﷺ the people will obtain deliverance from that hardship and distress, and the reckoning will begin. That right of intercession of the Prophet ﷺ is called “Maqam-e-Mahmud'.
(Bayan-ul-Qur'an)

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَالَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَّقِيَاماً۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: And they are those who spend the night (in the worship of Allah) prostrating and standing before their Lord.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (تَتَجَافَي جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفاً وَّطَمَعاً ز وَّمِمَّا رَزَقْنهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ ۞ فَلَاتَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَاأُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ ۚ جَزَاءً م بِما كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ۞).
